stories.title: Security forces kill terrorist commander in Qila Saifullah operation: state media
stories.brief: Security forces killed a terrorist commander of Fitna Al-Khawarij, Adil Shah, alias Darvesh, during an intelligence-based operation (IBO) in Qila Saifullah, Balochistan, under Operation Radd-ul-Fitna 3, Radio Pakistan reported, citing security sources.

stories.title: Rosebank: Life on the oil field at the centre of a political storm
stories.brief: Scotland editor James Cook finds out what life is like on board a ship in an untapped oil field awaiting its fate.

stories.title: FM Dar, Chinese envoy discuss CPEC, trade and regional stability
stories.brief: Jiang Zaidong, called on Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50. Read: Pakistan, China agree to align development plans, launch CPEC 2.0 Pakistan and China marked the 75th anniversary of their diplomatic relations this year, with both sides seeking to expand cooperation beyond traditional infrastructure projects.

stories.title: Musk says SpaceX restricted Ukraine's Starlink connection as service restored
stories.brief: The tech billionaire accuses Ukraine of violating its terms of service by using the network for military activity.

stories.title: Eleven sustain gunshot wounds in shooting near Florida university
stories.brief: Police said an altercation at a homecoming party escalated into gunfire, resulting in six adults and six juveniles injuredA shooting ⁠near a Florida university campus in Tallahassee has left 11 people ⁠with gunshot wounds ⁠and ​another person injured, authorities say.The shooting took place near the Florida Agricultural + Mechanical University’s campus ⁠on Perry Street on…

stories.title: From Russian cages to Irish sanctuary: The five-year rescue journey of Bu and Tyapa
stories.brief: For Bu and Tyapa, the five-year journey from Russia to the Irish countryside was anything but straightforward.

stories.title: Amber weather warning as Storm Boelo hits Scotland
stories.brief: The Met Office has issued an amber warning for wind over Scotland from 21:00 until 21:00 on Sunday.

stories.title: Storm Boelo to bring severe gales and heavy rain into Sunday
stories.brief: An amber weather warning has been issued for much of Scotland, parts of Northern Ireland and northern England, as Storm Boelo approaches.

stories.title: Wales plans to ban steel pylons as government launches consultation
stories.brief: The Welsh government says it is consulting on an "undergrounding-first approach" to electricity lines.

stories.title: White House lifts tariffs on some Canadian goods as midterm elections loom
stories.brief: From 30 October, tariffs will be eased on some products, including certain machinery, and placed on others, such as carpets.

stories.title: UK to invest £100m in 'world first' AI Biosecurity Lab
stories.brief: The chancellor will unveil AI spending aimed at shoring up the UK's defences in Wednesday's Budget.

stories.title: 500,000 Chromebooks to be distributed among students across country over 2 years, announces PM Shehbaz
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif announced on Sunday that the government would distribute 500,000 Chromebook laptops to students nationwide over two years. He said this at the launch ceremony of the Prime Minister’s Youth Chromebook Scheme in Islamabad.

stories.title: Hina Javed murder case: In open letter to Punjab CM, victim's family again expresses mistrust in police probe
stories.brief: Her husband and their domestic worker were arrested as Hina’s family accused them of murdering her while her father-in-law was questioned as part of the investigation. The family requested CM Maryam to look into the case file in detail and see the evidence linking Hina’s husband “to the murder being ignored from day one”.

stories.title: Hina Javed’s family seeks judicial commission in open letter to Punajb CM
stories.brief: The family raised questions about the handling of forensic evidence, alleging that DNA had been found on Hina’s neck belonging to Faisal and his father. Forensic reports concerning the mobile phones of Hina and the accused were still pending, the family said, adding that important messages had been deleted from her phone.

stories.title: Israeli defence minister admits having forced 2,000 Palestinians from homes in West Bank city of Hebron
stories.brief: Israel’s defence minister acknowledged Saturday that Israeli forces had forcibly displaced around 2,000 Palestinians from their homes in Hebron in the southern occupied West Bank.

stories.title: Wapda inks Rs133bn deal for Diamer-Bhasha Dam project
stories.brief: LAHORE: The Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority (Wapda) signed an agreement on Saturday with the Power China-IKAN Joint Venture for the Rs133.18 billion hydro-mechanical (HM-1) contract for the Diamer-Bhasha Dam project.

stories.title: US Justice Dept demands California counties help identify suspected noncitizen voters
stories.brief: On October 16, the Justice Department warned Los Angeles County and California election officials they could be liable as abettors of a federal crime if they count mail ballots returned by more than 20,000 people the Trump administration says are probably noncitizens.

stories.title: Dar orders urgent action to rein in rising wheat prices
stories.brief: Chairing a cabinet committee meeting to review the stocks, prices and supply of essential commodities, Mr Dar emphasised that safeguarding national food security and ensuring the availability of essential items at reasonable prices were government priorities.

stories.title: 11 shot near Florida A&M university in Tallahassee
stories.brief: A shooting near a Florida university campus in Tallahassee on Saturday night left 11 people with gunshot wounds and another injured, authorities said. The shooting took place near Florida Agricultural & Mechanical University's campus on Perry Street, the university said, while police counted six adults and six juveniles among the injured.

stories.title: Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted Houthi cruise missile over Khamis Mushait
stories.brief: The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen said on Sunday that it intercepted and destroyed a cruise missile launched by the Houthi group toward the southwestern Saudi city of Khamis Mushait.
